title: Combine two sorted arrays
prompt: a and b are each sorted from smallest to largest. Return a new sorted array that holds every number from both. Do it in one pass, with one index in each array.
hints: At each step, which two numbers are the only candidates for the next output?
Compare a[i] with b[j], push the smaller, and move that index forward.
When one array runs out, the rest of the other still has to be added.

rules.name: sort
rules.message: Use the fact that both arrays are already sorted. Do not call sort.

checkLabels: The two arrays are woven together in order.
An empty first array gives the second.
An empty second array gives the first.
The rest of the longer array is added.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Stops when one array runs out and drops the rest of the other.
Joins the arrays and sorts again, which ignores that they are already sorted.

feedback: Trace both indexes on the first check. When one index reaches the end of its array, what is left in the other?
